```{r knitr-setup, include=FALSE, purl=FALSE}

## analysis is the repository folder below; PRINCE_ROOT is set by run_pipeline.sh.
```

## Overview

Builds the v4 figure set (main Figures 1–4 and Extended Data Figs 1–10 in v4 numbering) from the patient-level primary analysis and the sensitivity arms. Its panels are the building blocks of the final figures. `comp_41_figures_v5` evaluates this script, keeps its panel objects and reassembles them, with new panels, into the final Figures 1–6 and Extended Data Figs 1 and 5. Several v4 Extended Data figures are used unchanged (title-free render) as final Extended Data Figs 3, 4 and 6–9.

Panel numbering therefore differs from the final figure numbering. The mapping used by the figure assembly is:

- v4 Fig. 1 → final Fig. 1a (design, `p1a`), Fig. 1c (composition, `p1d`) and Extended Data Fig. 1e–g (`p1c`, `p1e`, `p1f`).
- v4 Fig. 2 → final Fig. 2a (`p2a`), 2f (`p2c`), 2h (`p2b`), Fig. 3e,f (`p2e`, `p2f`) and Extended Data Fig. 5d (`p2d`).
- v4 Fig. 3 → final Fig. 4a–e.
- v4 Fig. 4 → final Fig. 5a–e.
- v4 Extended Data Fig. 1 → final Extended Data Fig. 1b–d.
- v4 Extended Data Fig. 3 → final Extended Data Fig. 5a–c, Fig. 4f (`e3c`) and Fig. 6e (`e3e`).
- v4 Extended Data Figs 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10 → final Extended Data Figs 3, 8, 9, 6, 4 and 7.

All association panels are at patient level (summed-count pseudobulk on the LOQ gene universe), with AOI-level mixed-model results shown only as confirmation. Plot titles and subtitles are working labels; they are removed in the final render (`comp_44_run_notitle`), and their content is carried in the legends.

**Figures, tables and results supported**

- Fig. 1a,c; Fig. 2a,f,h; Fig. 3e,f; Fig. 4a–f; Fig. 5a–e; Fig. 6e (panels reused by `comp_41_figures_v5`)
- Extended Data Fig. 1b–g and Extended Data Fig. 5a–d (panels reused by `comp_41_figures_v5`)
- Extended Data Fig. 3 (= v4 ExtendedDataFig4), Extended Data Fig. 4 (= v4 ExtendedDataFig9), Extended Data Fig. 6 (= v4 ExtendedDataFig8), Extended Data Fig. 7 (= v4 ExtendedDataFig10), Extended Data Fig. 8 (= v4 ExtendedDataFig5), Extended Data Fig. 9 (= v4 ExtendedDataFig6)
- p53 core-target induction table (Figures_v4/p53_core_target_paired_induction_LOQ.csv), copied forward by `comp_42_supp_tables_v5`
- The v1/v3 figures copied into Figures_v4 as SupplementaryFig1–5, ExtendedDataFig2 and ExtendedDataFig7 are intermediate; the final Supplementary Figures and Extended Data Figs 2 and 10 come from other scripts

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 28_figures_v4`. Approximate runtime: minutes.

## Analysis

### v4 figure set
The header lists the v4 figures and their content. Final figure numbering is given in the introduction above and at each section below.

Shared set-up: colour palettes for response group and compartment, a common ggplot theme, a save helper (PDF and PNG at 183 mm width), a helper that copies earlier figures into the v4 folder, Kaplan–Meier and Fisher-z confidence-interval helpers, and loading of the clinical table, AOI object, LOQ universes and the patient-pseudobulk results (`comp_13b`). `have_r6` lets the script run before the AOI-level arm exists. π₁ (1 − propTrueNull) is computed per stratum from the pseudobulk PSA-change P values.

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE figure set v4 -- figures
##   Fig 1  design, background (LOQ), composition, scale of detectable signal
##   Fig 2  target axis: FOLH1 and AR activity (patient pseudobulk + AOI-level mixed models)
##   Fig 3  on-treatment p53 and interferon pharmacodynamics
##   Fig 4  primary -> bone immune remodelling; IFN / antigen presentation and response;
##          comparison with Owen et al. (Cancer Res 2026)
##   ED1 LOQ background | ED2 deconvolution comparison | ED3 clinical/ctDNA (v1 ED7)
##   ED4 AOI-level analysis arm | ED5 re-evaluation of earlier hypotheses | ED6 purity
##   ED7 standR (v3 ED5) | ED8 primary-vs-bone quality controls | ED9 robustness / FOLH1 heterogeneity
##   ED10 Owen markers vs response (gene level)
##   Supplementary Figs S1-S4: v3 ED1 (RUV), ED6 (RUV AOI vs pseudobulk), ED8 (crosstalk), ED10 (AOI longitudinal)
## Inputs: R1_loq, R2_deconv_compare, R3_nepc_purity, R6_aoi_level, R7_owen_bone, C13_pseudobulk_LOQ(_exclLow)
## Output: results/Figures_v4/
## ============================================================================

source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))
suppressMessages({
  library(qs); library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(patchwork)
  library(ggrepel); library(survival); library(edgeR); library(limma); library(scales); library(ragg)
})
setwd(PRINCE_DIR)
check_ram_or_stop(20)
fig_dir <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "Figures_v4"); dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
v3_dir <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "Figures_v3"); v1_dir <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "Figures_v1")
C13 <- "C13_pseudobulk_LOQ"; R6 <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "R6_aoi_level"); R7 <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "R7_owen_bone")

resp_cols <- c(Responder = "#3B6FB6", Intermediate = "#E3A33B", Non_Responder = "#C0392B")
resp_lab <- c(Responder = "Responder", Intermediate = "Intermediate", Non_Responder = "Non-responder")
seg_cols <- c("CD45+" = "#7B9E3E", "PSMA+" = "#B5338A", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "#2C8C99")
seg_lab <- c("CD45+" = "CD45+", "PSMA+" = "PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "PanCK+PSMA−")
seg_cols_l <- setNames(seg_cols, seg_lab)
code <- c("CD45+" = "CD45", "PSMA+" = "PSMA", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "PanCKPSMA"); seg_from_code <- setNames(names(code), code)
tp_levels <- c("Archival", "Screening", "Cycle1")
tp_lab <- c(Archival = "Primary (archival)", Screening = "Bone, pre-treatment", Cycle1 = "Bone, on-treatment")
div_pal <- c("#2B5C8A", "#F7F7F7", "#B2412E")
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 7, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.3), axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3), axis.text = element_text(colour = "grey15"),
        strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 6), legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey30"),
        plot.tag = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"), plot.title.position = "plot"))
theme_tile <- theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())
save_fig <- function(p, name, h_mm, w_mm = 183) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm", device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 300, device = agg_png)
  cat("saved", name, "\n")
}
copy_fig <- function(from_dir, from, to) for (ext in c(".pdf", ".png")) file.copy(file.path(from_dir, paste0(from, ext)), file.path(fig_dir, paste0(to, ext)), overwrite = TRUE)
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1), formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
stars <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "", ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", ifelse(p < 0.01, "**", ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", ""))))
resp_scale <- list(scale_colour_manual(values = resp_cols, labels = resp_lab, name = NULL),
                   scale_fill_manual(values = resp_cols, labels = resp_lab, name = NULL))
strat_cols <- function(df, col = "stratum") df %>% mutate(segment = seg_from_code[sub("__.*", "", .data[[col]])],
  timepoint = factor(sub(".*__", "", .data[[col]]), tp_levels), seg_label = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab))
km_df <- function(time, event, group) {
  f <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ group)
  data.frame(time = f$time, surv = f$surv, n.censor = f$n.censor, strata = sub("group=", "", rep(names(f$strata), f$strata))) %>%
    group_by(strata) %>% group_modify(~ bind_rows(data.frame(time = 0, surv = 1, n.censor = 0), .x)) %>% ungroup()
}
rho_ci <- function(r, n) cbind(lo = tanh(atanh(r) - 1.96 / sqrt(n - 3)), hi = tanh(atanh(r) + 1.96 / sqrt(n - 3)))

pt <- qs::qread(out_path("C1_clinical", "patient_table.qs"))
se <- qs::qread("phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs"); cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
loq <- qs::qread(file.path(COMP_DIR, "R1_loq", "loq_gene_universes.qs"))
pbs <- qs::qread(out_path(C13, "pseudobulk_strata.qs"))
ft <- read.csv(out_path(C13, "feature_tests_pseudobulk.csv")) %>% strat_cols()
tw_all <- read.csv(out_path(C13, "transcriptome_wide_limma_all_strata.csv")) %>% strat_cols()
pdl <- read.csv(out_path(C13, "paired_induction_per_patient_deltas.csv"))
pres <- read.csv(out_path(C13, "paired_induction_apriori_sets.csv"))
pred <- read.csv(out_path(C13, "PSA50_prediction_cv_permutation.csv"))
have_r6 <- file.exists(file.path(R6, "C_aoi_on_treatment_change.csv"))
pb_val <- function(sid, gene) { p <- pbs[[sid]]
  data.frame(subject_id = p$meta$subject_id, value = p$lcpm[gene, ]) %>%
    left_join(pt %>% select(subject_id, response_group_neat, max_psa_change, r_pfstime, r_pfsevent, PSMAPET_vol_change_pct), by = "subject_id") }
pi1 <- tw_all %>% group_by(stratum, seg_label, timepoint) %>% summarise(pi1 = 1 - propTrueNull(P.Value, method = "lfdr"), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

```

### Figure 1 panels (final Fig. 1a,c and Extended Data Fig. 1e)
Study design schematic with patient and AOI counts per timepoint, computed from the data (final Fig. 1a); best-PSA-response waterfall (not used in the final figure); detection above the negative-probe LOQ for selected genes per stratum (final Extended Data Fig. 1e); and mean SpatialDecon composition per compartment in primary and bone, with fine cell types collapsed to lineages and averaged over non-control AOIs (final Fig. 1c).

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-02}
## =====================================================================================
## Figure 1 -- design, background, composition, scale of signal
## =====================================================================================
ncd <- cd %>% filter(response_group_neat != "Control", timepoint %in% tp_levels)
n_by_tp <- ncd %>% group_by(timepoint) %>% summarise(p = n_distinct(subject_id), a = n(), .groups = "drop")
tl <- data.frame(x = c(1, 2.6, 4.2), tp = tp_levels,
  lab = c("Archival primary\ntumour (diagnosis)", "Bone metastasis\npre-treatment", "Bone metastasis\non-treatment (wk 2–4)")) %>%
  left_join(n_by_tp, by = c(tp = "timepoint")) %>% mutate(sub = sprintf("%d patients · %d AOIs", p, a))
roi <- data.frame(seg = names(seg_cols), x = 5.55 + c(-0.42, 0, 0.42))
p1a <- ggplot() +
  annotate("segment", x = 0.6, xend = 4.75, y = 0.5, yend = 0.5, linewidth = 0.4, arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.5, "mm"), type = "closed")) +

    length(unique(ncd$subject_id)), nrow(distinct(ncd, subject_id, timepoint, roi_name)), nrow(ncd))) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 5.0, xmax = 6.1, ymin = 0.15, ymax = 0.98, fill = NA, colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = 2) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = seg_cols, guide = "none") + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.4, 6.2), ylim = c(-0.05, 1.05)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 7) + theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"))
ord <- pt %>% arrange(max_psa_change) %>% pull(subject_id)
p1b <- ggplot(pt %>% mutate(subject_id = factor(subject_id, ord), response_group_neat = factor(response_group_neat, names(resp_cols))),
              aes(subject_id, pmin(max_psa_change, 150), fill = response_group_neat)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) + geom_hline(yintercept = c(-50, 0), linetype = c(2, 1), linewidth = 0.25) + resp_scale +
  annotate("text", x = 33, y = 165, label = "capped at +150%", hjust = 1, size = 1.6, colour = "grey40") +

  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), legend.position = c(0.3, 0.88), legend.background = element_blank())
det <- read.csv(file.path(COMP_DIR, "R1_loq", "gene_detection_rates.csv")) %>% strat_cols()
gord <- c("KLK3", "FOLH1", "TMPRSS2", "AR", "MDM2", "CDKN1A", "B2M", "HLA-B", "CD276", "IBSP", "CTSK", "SYP", "NEUROD1", "CHGA", "INSM1", "ASCL1")
det <- det %>% filter(gene %in% gord) %>% mutate(gene = factor(gene, rev(gord)), tpl = factor(c(Archival = "Primary", Screening = "Bone pre", Cycle1 = "Bone on")[as.character(timepoint)], c("Primary", "Bone pre", "Bone on")))
p1c <- ggplot(det, aes(tpl, gene, fill = detection)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(100 * detection), colour = detection > 0.6), size = 1.6) +
  facet_grid(~seg_label, labeller = as_labeller(c("CD45+" = "CD45+", "PSMA+" = "PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA−" = "PanCK+\nPSMA−"))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey15", `TRUE` = "white"), guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4F6F8", high = "#1F3A5F", labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1), name = "AOIs above\nbackground") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Detection above negative-probe background", subtitle = "LOQ = geomean × geoSD² of 139 negative probes; % of AOIs") +
  theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, size = 5.5), axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 5.6), strip.text = element_text(size = 5.6))
dec <- qs::qread(out_path("C3_deconvolution", "deconvolution_proportions.qs")); Pp <- dec$prop_primary; Pb <- dec$prop_bone
lin_p <- c(Luminal = "Tumour", Basal = "Tumour", Club = "Tumour", Hillock = "Tumour", LPCs = "Tumour", NE = "Tumour", CD4T = "T/NK", CD8T = "T/NK",
  NK = "T/NK", T_MKI67 = "T/NK", B = "B/plasma", Plasma_B = "B/plasma", Mph = "Myeloid", Mono = "Myeloid", DCs = "Myeloid", Neutrophils = "Myeloid",
  Mye_cycling = "Myeloid", Mast = "Myeloid", CAFs = "Stroma", Mural = "Stroma", Pericytes = "Stroma", Endo = "Endothelial")
lin_b <- function(t) case_when(grepl("^Tumour", t) ~ "Tumour", grepl("CD4|CD8|CTL|NK|Th|Treg", t) ~ "T/NK",
  grepl("^B|B$|Bcell|B cells|Plasma|Pro-B|Pre-B|Mature B|Immature B", t) ~ "B/plasma", grepl("Mono|TAM|TIM|DC|Neutro|Mast|Macro", t) ~ "Myeloid",
  grepl("Osteo", t) ~ "Bone cells", grepl("Erythro|Progen", t) ~ "Erythroid/progenitor", grepl("Endo", t) ~ "Endothelial",
  grepl("Peri|Fibro|MSC|Stromal", t) ~ "Stroma", TRUE ~ "Other")
coarse <- function(P, f) { m <- if (is.function(f)) f(colnames(P)) else f[colnames(P)]; m[is.na(m)] <- "Other"
  sapply(split(colnames(P), m), function(cc) rowSums(P[, cc, drop = FALSE])) }
comp <- bind_rows(data.frame(coarse(Pp, lin_p), aoi = rownames(Pp), site = "Primary", check.names = FALSE),
                  data.frame(coarse(Pb, lin_b), aoi = rownames(Pb), site = "Bone", check.names = FALSE)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(aoi, site), names_to = "lineage", values_to = "prop") %>% filter(!is.na(prop)) %>%
  mutate(segment = cd[aoi, "segment_name"], resp = cd[aoi, "response_group_neat"], tp = cd[aoi, "timepoint"]) %>%
  filter(resp != "Control", tp %in% tp_levels) %>% group_by(site, segment, lineage) %>% summarise(prop = mean(prop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(site, segment) %>% mutate(prop = prop / sum(prop)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(site = factor(site, c("Primary", "Bone")), segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab),
         lineage = factor(lineage, c("Tumour", "T/NK", "B/plasma", "Myeloid", "Stroma", "Endothelial", "Bone cells", "Erythroid/progenitor", "Other")))
lin_cols <- c("Tumour" = "#8C6D9E", "T/NK" = "#4C9F70", "B/plasma" = "#A3C586", "Myeloid" = "#E39B3C", "Stroma" = "#B07A5A",
              "Endothelial" = "#D35F5F", "Bone cells" = "#6A8EAE", "Erythroid/progenitor" = "#C9A3B8", "Other" = "grey80")
p1d <- ggplot(comp, aes(site, prop, fill = lineage)) + geom_col(width = 0.78, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) + facet_grid(~segment) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lin_cols, name = NULL) + scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean deconvolved fraction", title = "Composition (SpatialDecon)", subtitle = "Tissue-matched references: PCCAT primary; GSE143791 bone + PCCAT CRPC") +
  theme(legend.key.size = unit(2.4, "mm"), legend.text = element_text(size = 5.5))
## e: scale of signal -- AOI-level (patient-blocked) and patient-level gene counts vs permutation null; pi1
sig_scale <- tw_all %>% group_by(stratum) %>% summarise(pb_fdr10 = sum(adj.P.Val < 0.1), .groups = "drop") %>% left_join(pi1, by = "stratum")
```

Extended Data Fig. 1f,g panels: AOI-level patient-blocked gene counts for PSA change against the 200-permutation null (from `comp_26`), and P-value histograms of the patient pseudobulk gene–PSA tests with π₁ per stratum. The v4 Figure 1 is then assembled and saved.

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-03}
if (have_r6) {
  a6 <- read.csv(file.path(R6, "A_aoi_permutation_calibration.csv")) %>% filter(contrast == "PSA") %>% strat_cols()
  a6 <- a6 %>% mutate(ylab = factor(paste(seg_label, c(Archival = "Primary", Screening = "Pre-treatment bone", Cycle1 = "On-treatment bone")[as.character(timepoint)], sep = " · "),
    as.vector(outer(seg_lab, c("Primary", "Pre-treatment bone", "On-treatment bone"), paste, sep = " · "))))
  p1e <- ggplot(a6, aes(y = ylab)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = 0.5, xmax = perm_95pct + 0.5), linewidth = 2.2, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_point(aes(x = perm_median + 0.5), shape = 124, size = 2.5, colour = "grey45") +
    geom_point(aes(x = observed_fdr05 + 0.5, colour = segment), size = 1.8) +
    geom_text(aes(x = 2e4, label = sprintf("%d (P = %.2f)", observed_fdr05, perm_p)), hjust = 1, size = 1.7) +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(0.5, 2e4), labels = function(x) x - 0.5, breaks = c(0.5, 1.5, 10.5, 100.5, 1000.5)) + scale_colour_manual(values = seg_cols, guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Genes at FDR < 0.05 (AOI-level, patient-blocked)", y = NULL, title = "AOI-level gene counts vs patient-shuffled null",
         subtitle = "Dot, observed; tick, null median; bar, to null 95th percentile") +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.3))
} else p1e <- plot_spacer()
p1f <- ggplot(tw_all, aes(P.Value)) + geom_histogram(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.05), fill = "grey60", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_text(data = sig_scale, aes(x = 0.5, y = Inf, label = sprintf("π₁ = %.0f%%", 100 * pmax(pi1, 0))), vjust = 1.3, size = 1.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(seg_label ~ timepoint, scales = "free_y", labeller = labeller(timepoint = c(Archival = "Primary", Screening = "Bone pre", Cycle1 = "Bone on"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = "P, gene vs PSA change (patient pseudobulk)", y = "Genes", title = "Patient-level: 0–1 genes at FDR < 0.1",
       subtitle = "π₁, estimated fraction of response-associated genes") +
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 5.5), strip.text.x = element_text(size = 5.5), axis.line.y = element_blank())
fig1 <- (p1a / (p1b | p1d) / (p1c | (p1e / p1f + plot_layout(heights = c(0.9, 1.3))) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.2, 1)))) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.55, 0.8, 1.9)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
save_fig(fig1, "Figure1", 235)
```

### Figure 2 panels (final Fig. 2a,f,h, Fig. 3e,f, Extended Data Fig. 5d)
- `p2a`: Spearman ρ (Fisher 95% CI) of patient *FOLH1* with maximal PSA change in each stratum, with the unadjusted P, batch-adjusted P and AOI-level mixed-model permutation P (final Fig. 2a).
- `p2b`: pre-treatment PanCK+PSMA− *FOLH1* vs PSA change (final Fig. 2h).
- `p2c`: primary vs matched bone *FOLH1* per compartment (final Fig. 2f).
- `p2d`: external AR signatures (singscore) vs PSA change (final Extended Data Fig. 5d).
- `p2e`: on-treatment PSMA+ Hallmark androgen score vs PSMA-PET tumour-volume change (final Fig. 3e).
- `p2f`: rPFS by median split of on-treatment PSMA+ *FOLH1*, with log-rank P and the per-s.d. Cox HR from `comp_13b` (final Fig. 3f).

### Figure 3 panels (final Fig. 4a–e)
For each compartment, build a joint pseudobulk of paired Screening and Cycle1 samples over the union of both LOQ universes and compute per-patient changes in the ten canonical p53 targets. Each gene is tested by Wilcoxon signed-rank test with BH-FDR within compartment; genes below LOQ drop out, so fewer genes appear in some compartments. The resulting table is written as `p53_core_target_paired_induction_LOQ.csv`. Panels: per-patient p53-target change in PanCK+PSMA− (final Fig. 4a); median change and patients increasing per compartment (4b); interferon/antigen-presentation programme change from `comp_13b`, annotated with the AOI-level mixed-model P from `comp_26` (4c); detection above LOQ before and on treatment (4d); and change in Hallmark IFN-α vs PSA change (4e).

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-05}
## =====================================================================================
## Figure 3 -- on-treatment pharmacodynamics
## =====================================================================================
p53_core <- c("CDKN1A", "MDM2", "DDB2", "PHLDA3", "GDF15", "TNFRSF10B", "SESN1", "ZMAT3", "RRM2B", "TP53I3")
paired <- list()
for (sg in names(seg_cols)) {
  idx <- which(cd$segment_name == sg & cd$timepoint %in% c("Screening", "Cycle1") & cd$response_group_neat != "Control"); d <- cd[idx, ]
  key <- paste(d$subject_id, d$timepoint, sep = "|"); cc <- assay(se, "all_count")[, idx]
  g_pair <- union(loq$universes[[paste0(code[sg], "__Screening")]]$g10, loq$universes[[paste0(code[sg], "__Cycle1")]]$g10)
  m <- sapply(split(seq_along(key), key), function(i) rowSums(cc[g_pair, i, drop = FALSE]))
  sid <- sub("\\|.*", "", colnames(m)); both <- names(which(table(sid) == 2)); m <- m[, sid %in% both]
  lc <- cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(m)), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1); g <- intersect(p53_core, rownames(lc))
  paired[[sg]] <- data.frame(t(lc[g, , drop = FALSE]), key = colnames(lc), check.names = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(subject_id = sub("\\|.*", "", key), timepoint = sub(".*\\|", "", key)) %>% select(-key) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(subject_id, timepoint), names_to = "gene", values_to = "v") %>% pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = v) %>%
    mutate(delta = Cycle1 - Screening, segment = sg)
}
paired <- bind_rows(paired) %>% left_join(pt %>% select(subject_id, response_group_neat, max_psa_change), by = "subject_id")
p53_tab <- paired %>% group_by(segment, gene) %>% summarise(n = n(), n_up = sum(delta > 0), med = median(delta),
  p = wilcox.test(delta, exact = FALSE)$p.value, .groups = "drop") %>% group_by(segment) %>% mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p, "BH")) %>% ungroup()
write.csv(p53_tab, file.path(fig_dir, "p53_core_target_paired_induction_LOQ.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
# PanCK+PSMA- order first, then genes measurable only in other compartments (avoids NA levels in the heatmap)
gorder <- unique(c(p53_tab %>% filter(segment == "PanCK+PSMA-") %>% arrange(desc(med)) %>% pull(gene), p53_tab %>% arrange(desc(med)) %>% pull(gene)))
p3a <- ggplot(paired %>% filter(segment == "PanCK+PSMA-") %>% mutate(gene = factor(gene, gorder), response_group_neat = factor(response_group_neat, names(resp_cols))), aes(gene, delta)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey40", fill = "grey95") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = response_group_neat), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, seed = 1), size = 0.95) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = resp_cols, labels = resp_lab, name = NULL, drop = TRUE) +
  geom_text(data = p53_tab %>% filter(segment == "PanCK+PSMA-") %>% mutate(gene = factor(gene, gorder)),
            aes(gene, Inf, label = sprintf("%d/%d\nq = %s", n_up, n, fmt_p(fdr))), vjust = 1.1, size = 1.6, lineheight = 0.85, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.28))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Δ log2 CPM (on − pre-treatment)",
  title = "Radioligand therapy induces canonical p53 targets", subtitle = "Paired PanCK+PSMA− pseudobulk, 14 patients; patients increasing / pairs; Wilcoxon q") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic"), legend.position = "top")
p53_heat <- p53_tab %>% mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab), gene = factor(gene, gorder))
p3b <- ggplot(p53_heat, aes(gene, segment, fill = med)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(fdr < 0.05, sprintf("%d/%d*", n_up, n), sprintf("%d/%d", n_up, n))), size = 1.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-1.2, 1.2), oob = squish, name = "Median Δ\nlog2 CPM") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Induction in every compartment", subtitle = "Patients increasing / pairs; * q < 0.05") +
  theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(face = "italic", angle = 30, hjust = 1))
detr <- read.csv(file.path(COMP_DIR, "R1_loq", "gene_detection_rates.csv")) %>% strat_cols() %>%
  filter(gene %in% c("MDM2", "CDKN1A", "PHLDA3", "GDF15", "STAT1", "ISG15"), timepoint %in% c("Screening", "Cycle1")) %>%
  mutate(gene = factor(gene, c("CDKN1A", "MDM2", "PHLDA3", "GDF15", "STAT1", "ISG15")), tpl = factor(c(Screening = "Pre", Cycle1 = "On")[as.character(timepoint)], c("Pre", "On")))
p3c <- ggplot(detr, aes(tpl, detection, group = seg_label, colour = seg_label)) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.45) + geom_point(size = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~gene, nrow = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = seg_cols_l, name = NULL) + scale_y_continuous(labels = percent, limits = c(0, 0.75)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "AOIs above background", title = "Independent confirmation: detection above the negative-probe background") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold.italic"))
pres2 <- pres %>% filter(programme %in% c("Hallmark_P53", "Hallmark_IFNa", "IFN_I", "IFN_I_STING_tumour", "MHC_I", "MHC_II")) %>%
  mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab), programme = factor(recode(programme, Hallmark_P53 = "Hallmark p53", Hallmark_IFNa = "Hallmark IFN-α",
  IFN_I = "Type I IFN", IFN_I_STING_tumour = "IFN-I/STING", MHC_I = "MHC class I", MHC_II = "MHC class II"),
  rev(c("Hallmark p53", "Hallmark IFN-α", "Type I IFN", "IFN-I/STING", "MHC class I", "MHC class II"))))
if (have_r6) {
  ch6 <- read.csv(file.path(R6, "C_aoi_on_treatment_change.csv")) %>% filter(feature %in% c("Hallmark_P53", "Hallmark_IFNa", "IFN_I", "IFN_I_STING_tumour", "MHC_I", "MHC_II")) %>%
    mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab), programme = recode(feature, Hallmark_P53 = "Hallmark p53", Hallmark_IFNa = "Hallmark IFN-α",
      IFN_I = "Type I IFN", IFN_I_STING_tumour = "IFN-I/STING", MHC_I = "MHC class I", MHC_II = "MHC class II")) %>% select(segment, programme, p_aoi = p_change)
  pres2 <- left_join(pres2, ch6, by = c("segment", "programme"))
} else pres2$p_aoi <- NA
p3d <- ggplot(pres2, aes(segment, programme, fill = median_delta)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s%s\n%s", stars(p_induction), sprintf("%d/%d", n_up, n_pairs), ifelse(is.na(p_aoi), "", paste0("AOI ", stars(p_aoi), ifelse(p_aoi < 0.05, "", "ns"))))),
            size = 1.5, lineheight = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-0.6, 0.6), oob = squish, name = "Median Δ\n(z-score)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Interferon and antigen-presentation programmes", subtitle = "Patients up / pairs (pseudobulk Wilcoxon *); AOI, AOI-level mixed model") +
  theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
dd <- pdl %>% filter(programme == "Hallmark_IFNa", segment %in% names(seg_cols)) %>% mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab))
dl_lab <- pres %>% filter(programme == "Hallmark_IFNa") %>% mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab), txt = sprintf("ρ = %.2f\nP = %s\nn = %d pairs", rho_delta_psa, fmt_p(p_rho_delta_psa), n_pairs))
p3e <- ggplot(dd, aes(pmin(max_psa_change, 150), delta, colour = response_group_neat)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -50, linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(size = 1.3) + facet_wrap(~segment, nrow = 1) + resp_scale +
  geom_text(data = dl_lab, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = txt), hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.15, size = 1.7, lineheight = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-100, -50, 0, 50, 100, 150)) +
  labs(x = "Maximal PSA change (%, capped at +150)", y = "Δ Hallmark IFN-α (z)", title = "Greater interferon induction accompanies better PSA response") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### Figure 4 panels (final Fig. 5a–e)
Primary-to-bone programme change with the robustness mark (Wilcoxon FDR < 0.1 and expression-matched FDR < 0.05), Owen et al. markers with the direction they reported and AOI-level confirmation, the within-patient *CD276*–IFN/HLA associations, Spearman correlation of IFN, HLA and myeloid programmes with PSA change (‡ when P < 0.05 in every leave-one-out refit), and on-treatment PanCK+PSMA− HLA class I score vs PSA change. Inputs are from `comp_27_owen_bone` and the pseudobulk strata.

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-07}
## =====================================================================================
## Figure 4 -- primary -> bone remodelling, IFN/antigen presentation and response, Owen et al.
## =====================================================================================
prog_lab <- c(IFN_I_core = "IFN-I core (IRF9/STAT1/STING)", Hallmark_IFNa = "Hallmark IFN-α", Hallmark_IFNg = "Hallmark IFN-γ", HLA_I = "HLA class I",
  HLA_II = "HLA class II", Checkpoints = "Immune checkpoints", CD8_cytotoxic = "CD8 cytotoxic", Treg = "Treg", TAM_TIM_Kfoury = "TAM/TIM (bone)",
  M2_macrophage = "M2 macrophage", cDC2_tolerogenic = "cDC2 / mDC", DC_priming = "DC priming (LN-like)")
pr <- read.csv(file.path(R7, "A_primary_vs_bone_programmes.csv")) %>% filter(analysis == "all") %>%
  mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab), programme = factor(prog_lab[programme], rev(prog_lab)),
         robust = fdr_wilcox < 0.1 & fdr_expr_matched < 0.05)
p4a <- ggplot(pr, aes(segment, programme, fill = mean_delta_z)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d/%d%s", n_patients - n_down, n_patients, ifelse(robust, "†", stars(p_wilcox)))), size = 1.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-0.8, 0.8), oob = squish, name = "Mean Δ\n(z, bone −\nprimary)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Primary tumour → bone metastasis", subtitle = "Paired patients (higher in bone / pairs); * Wilcoxon P;\n† q < 0.1 and robust to expression-matched null") +
  theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
gsel <- c("HLA-B", "B2M", "STAT1", "IRF9", "STING1", "CD274", "CD276", "CD44", "TP53", "SPP1", "CD68", "CD163", "EPCAM")
og <- read.csv(file.path(R7, "A_primary_vs_bone_owen_genes.csv")) %>% filter(analysis == "all", gene %in% gsel) %>%
  left_join(read.csv(file.path(R7, "C_aoi_primary_vs_bone_owen_genes.csv")) %>% select(segment, gene, logFC_aoi, FDR_aoi), by = c("segment", "gene")) %>%
  mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab), gene = factor(gene, rev(gsel)))
owen_dir <- c("HLA-B" = "down", B2M = "down", STAT1 = "down", IRF9 = "down", STING1 = "down", CD274 = "down", CD276 = "up", CD44 = "down", TP53 = "down",
              SPP1 = "up", CD68 = "up", CD163 = "up", EPCAM = "up")
p4b <- ggplot(og, aes(segment, gene)) + geom_point(aes(size = pmin(-log10(FDR), 4), fill = logFC), shape = 21, colour = "grey30", stroke = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = ~ filter(.x, FDR_aoi < 0.05), aes(segment, gene), shape = 4, size = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE, position = position_nudge(x = 0.32)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = "white", high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-1.5, 1.5), oob = squish, name = "log2FC\nbone vs\nprimary") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 3.6, breaks = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("0.1", "0.01", "≤0.001"), name = "q (pseudobulk)") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(g) sprintf("%s (Owen: %s)", g, owen_dir[g])) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Owen et al. markers, bone vs primary", subtitle = "× AOI-level (patient-blocked) q < 0.05") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.4), legend.box = "horizontal")
b7 <- read.csv(file.path(R7, "D_CD276_vs_IFN_HLA.csv")) %>% filter(target %in% c("IFN_I_core", "HLA_I", "B2M", "IRF9", "STAT1")) %>%
  mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab), tpl = factor(c(Archival = "Primary", Screening = "Bone pre", Cycle1 = "Bone on")[timepoint], c("Primary", "Bone pre", "Bone on")),
         target = factor(recode(target, IFN_I_core = "IFN-I core", HLA_I = "HLA class I"), c("IFN-I core", "HLA class I", "B2M", "IRF9", "STAT1")))
p4c <- ggplot(b7, aes(tpl, target, fill = beta_within)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", beta_within), stars(p_within))), size = 1.6) + facet_grid(~segment) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-0.7, 0.7), oob = squish, name = "Within-patient\nβ (s.d./s.d.)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "B7-H3 (CD276) co-varies positively with IFN-I/HLA-I in bone", subtitle = "AOI-level mixed model, target ~ CD276 + (1 | patient); Owen et al. predict negative") +
  theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
rs <- read.csv(file.path(R7, "E_owen_markers_vs_response.csv")) %>% filter(type == "programme", feature %in% c("IFN_I_core", "Hallmark_IFNa", "Hallmark_IFNg", "HLA_I", "HLA_II", "TAM_TIM_Kfoury", "M2_macrophage")) %>%
  strat_cols() %>% mutate(feature = factor(prog_lab[feature], rev(prog_lab)), tpl = factor(c(Archival = "Primary", Screening = "Bone pre", Cycle1 = "Bone on")[as.character(timepoint)], c("Primary", "Bone pre", "Bone on")),
  mark = ifelse(p_rho < 0.05 & p_LOO_worst < 0.05, "‡", stars(p_rho)))
p4d <- ggplot(rs, aes(tpl, feature, fill = rho)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) + geom_text(aes(label = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", rho), mark)), size = 1.55) +
  facet_grid(~seg_label) + scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-0.8, 0.8), oob = squish, name = "ρ with\nPSA change") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "On treatment, IFN and HLA programmes track response", subtitle = "Negative ρ = higher with greater PSA fall; * P < 0.05; ‡ also P < 0.05 at every leave-one-out") +
  theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
sc4 <- {p <- pbs[["PanCKPSMA__Cycle1"]]; z <- t(scale(t(p$lcpm))); g <- intersect(c("HLA-A", "HLA-B", "HLA-C", "B2M", "TAP1", "TAP2", "TAPBP"), rownames(z))
  data.frame(subject_id = p$meta$subject_id, score = colMeans(z[g, ])) %>% left_join(pt %>% select(subject_id, response_group_neat, max_psa_change, r_pfstime, r_pfsevent), by = "subject_id")}
r4e <- cor.test(sc4$score, sc4$max_psa_change, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
p4e <- ggplot(sc4, aes(score, pmin(max_psa_change, 150), colour = response_group_neat)) + geom_hline(yintercept = -50, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) + resp_scale + theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x = "HLA class I score, on-treatment PanCK+PSMA−", y = "Maximal PSA change (%, capped)", title = "Antigen presentation on treatment",
       subtitle = sprintf("ρ = %.2f, P = %s (n = %d)", r4e$estimate, fmt_p(r4e$p.value), nrow(sc4)))
fig4 <- ((p4a | p4b) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.1))) / p4c / ((p4d | p4e) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.9, 1))) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.25, 0.65, 0.95)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
save_fig(fig4, "Figure4", 235)
```

### Extended Data Fig. 1b–d
Per-AOI standard LOQ (geometric mean × geometric s.d.² of the negative probes) against the earlier 2 × geometric-mean threshold, the percentage of genes above LOQ per AOI (dashed line at the 5% low-signal cut-off) and gene-universe size by detection threshold. Two earlier figures are copied into the v4 folder for completeness (intermediate).


```{r comp-28-figures-v4-10}
    theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
  ch <- read.csv(file.path(R6, "C_aoi_on_treatment_change.csv")) %>% filter(feature %in% c(p53_core, "P53_core", "Hallmark_IFNa", "MHC_I", "IFN_I_STING_tumour", "AR_Hallmark", "FOLH1")) %>%
    mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab), feature = factor(recode(feature, P53_core = "p53 core (10 genes)", Hallmark_IFNa = "IFN-α", MHC_I = "MHC-I",
      IFN_I_STING_tumour = "IFN-I/STING", AR_Hallmark = "AR (Hallmark)")), )
  e4d <- ggplot(ch, aes(feature, segment, fill = change)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(fdr_change < 0.05, "*", "")), size = 2.4, vjust = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-1, 1), oob = squish, name = "On − pre\n(AOI-LMM)") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "On-treatment change at AOI level, feature ~ timepoint + (1 | patient)", subtitle = "* q < 0.05") +
    theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 50, hjust = 1, size = 5))
  save_fig(e4a / (e4b | e4d + plot_layout()) / e4c + plot_layout(heights = c(1.1, 0.8, 1.15)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a"), "ExtendedDataFig4", 230)
}
```

### v4 Extended Data Fig. 8 = final Extended Data Fig. 6 (primary vs bone quality controls)
From `comp_27`: (a) matched primary and bone AOI signal depth with paired Wilcoxon P; (b) gene-wise log2 fold change against mean expression with loess fit, to show any intensity-dependent component; (c) programme changes in the primary analysis vs the expression-matched, quality-adjusted and low-signal-excluded versions; (d) Owen et al. markers, pseudobulk vs AOI-level log2 fold change with Pearson r.

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-13}
## =====================================================================================
## ED8 -- primary-vs-bone controls for tissue type, decalcification and RNA quality
## =====================================================================================
gq <- read.csv(file.path(R7, "B_primary_vs_bone_global_quality.csv"))
qa <- loq$aoi; qa$segment <- cd[rownames(qa), "segment_name"]; qa$timepoint <- cd[rownames(qa), "timepoint"]; qa$subject_id <- cd[rownames(qa), "subject_id"]
qa <- qa %>% filter(timepoint %in% c("Archival", "Screening"), cd[rownames(qa), "response_group_neat"] != "Control") %>% group_by(segment, subject_id, timepoint) %>%
  summarise(q = mean(pct_above_LOQ_std), .groups = "drop") %>% group_by(segment, subject_id) %>% filter(n() == 2) %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(site = factor(ifelse(timepoint == "Archival", "Primary", "Bone"), c("Primary", "Bone")), segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab))
e8a <- ggplot(qa, aes(site, q)) + geom_line(aes(group = subject_id), colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.25) + geom_point(aes(colour = segment), size = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~segment) + scale_colour_manual(values = seg_cols_l, guide = "none") + scale_y_log10() +
  geom_text(data = gq %>% filter(analysis == "all") %>% mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab)), aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = sprintf("paired P = %.2f", p_q)), vjust = 1.2, size = 1.7, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% genes above LOQ (patient mean)", title = "AOI signal quality does not differ between matched primary and bone tissue")
allg <- qs::qread(file.path(R7, "A_primary_vs_bone_all_genes.qs")) %>% filter(analysis == "all") %>% mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab))
e8b <- ggplot(allg, aes(AveExpr, logFC)) + geom_hex(bins = 60) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, colour = "#B2412E", linewidth = 0.4, formula = y ~ x, span = 0.5) + facet_wrap(~segment) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey90", high = "grey20", trans = "log10", name = "Genes") + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 3)) +
  labs(x = "Mean log2 CPM", y = "log2FC, bone vs primary", title = "Gene-wise log2FC vs mean expression (red, loess)")
pa <- read.csv(file.path(R7, "A_primary_vs_bone_programmes.csv")) %>% select(analysis, segment, programme, mean_logFC, mean_rel_logFC, mean_logFC_qadj) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = analysis, values_from = c(mean_logFC, mean_rel_logFC, mean_logFC_qadj)) %>% mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab))
pa_long <- bind_rows(pa %>% transmute(segment, programme, x = mean_logFC_all, y = mean_rel_logFC_all, comp = "Expression-matched"),
                     pa %>% transmute(segment, programme, x = mean_logFC_all, y = mean_logFC_qadj_all, comp = "Quality-adjusted"),
                     pa %>% transmute(segment, programme, x = mean_logFC_all, y = mean_logFC_exclLow, comp = "Low-signal AOIs excluded"))
e8c <- ggplot(pa_long, aes(x, y, colour = segment)) + geom_abline(linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.25) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2, colour = "grey70") + geom_point(size = 1.1) + facet_wrap(~comp) +
  geom_text_repel(data = ~ filter(.x, abs(x) > 0.35), aes(label = prog_lab[programme]), size = 1.5, segment.size = 0.15, max.overlaps = 20, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = seg_cols_l, name = NULL) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1, -0.5, 0)) + theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(4, "mm")) +
  labs(x = "Programme mean log2FC, bone vs primary (primary analysis)", y = "Sensitivity analysis", title = "Programme changes are robust to three quality controls")
ag <- read.csv(file.path(R7, "A_primary_vs_bone_owen_genes.csv")) %>% filter(analysis == "all") %>%
  inner_join(read.csv(file.path(R7, "C_aoi_primary_vs_bone_owen_genes.csv")), by = c("segment", "gene")) %>% mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab))
rg <- cor(ag$logFC, ag$logFC_aoi)
e8d <- ggplot(ag, aes(logFC, logFC_aoi, colour = segment)) + geom_abline(linetype = 3, linewidth = 0.25) + geom_point(size = 1) +
  geom_text_repel(data = ~ filter(.x, abs(logFC) > 0.6), aes(label = gene), size = 1.5, segment.size = 0.15, show.legend = FALSE, fontface = "italic") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = seg_cols_l, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "log2FC, patient pseudobulk (paired)", y = "log2FC, AOI-level (patient-blocked)", title = sprintf("Owen et al. markers: pseudobulk vs AOI level (r = %.2f)", rg))
save_fig(e8a / e8b / (e8c) / (e8d | plot_spacer() + plot_layout()) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.8, 0.8, 0.9, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a"), "ExtendedDataFig8", 235)
```

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-14}
R22 <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "R22_tme_on_treatment")
tl <- c(Tcell_inflamed_GEP = "T-cell-inflamed GEP", IFNG_6gene_Ayers = "IFN-γ 6-gene", CD8_effector = "CD8 effector", Cytotoxic_effector = "Cytotoxic effector",
        T_exhaustion = "T-cell exhaustion", T_exhaustion_terminal = "Terminal exhaustion", Immune_checkpoints = "Immune checkpoints", Tcell_stemness_TCF7 = "TCF7 stem-like",
        MDSC_like = "MDSC-like", M1_macrophage = "M1 macrophage", M2_macrophage = "M2 macrophage", Neutrophil = "Neutrophil", TGFb_response_FTBRS = "TGF-β response", Bone_TAM_TIM = "Bone TAM/TIM",
        Treg = "Treg", B_cell = "B cell", Plasma_cell = "Plasma cell", TLS_12_chemokine = "TLS chemokines", Proliferation = "Proliferation", Osteoclast = "Osteoclast", Osteoblast = "Osteoblast")
tm <- read.csv(file.path(R22, "A_tme_programme_gene_change.csv")) %>%
  mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[c("CD45+" = "CD45+", "PSMA+" = "PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "PanCK+PSMA-")[segment]], seg_lab),
         type = ifelse(family == "genes", "Genes", "Programmes"), lab = ifelse(family == "genes", feature, tl[feature]),
         slp = sign(median_change) * -log10(p_change), txt = paste0(n_up, "/", n_pairs, ifelse(fdr_change < 0.05, "**", ifelse(fdr_change < 0.1, "*", ""))))
tm$lab <- factor(tm$lab, rev(unique(c(tl, sort(unique(tm$feature[tm$family == "genes"]))))))
e9f <- ggplot(tm, aes(segment, lab, fill = slp)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_text(aes(label = txt), size = 1.45) +
  facet_grid(type ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-3, 3), oob = squish, name = "Signed\n−log10 P\n(+, higher\non treatment)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5))
```

Extended Data Fig. 4g panel: median change in library-size-weighted deconvolved fractions on treatment (`comp_50`); individual immune cell types are marked as exploratory. The nine-panel v4 Extended Data Fig. 9 is then saved.

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-15}
dc <- read.csv(file.path(R22, "D_deconvolved_change.csv")) %>% filter(!cell_type %in% c("TIM", "NK", "mDC")) %>%
  mutate(segment = factor(seg_lab[segment], seg_lab),
         cell = factor(recode(cell_type, B_plasma = "B/plasma", Bone_cells = "Bone cells", Epithelial_tumour = "Tumour", Erythroid_progenitor = "Erythroid/progenitor",
                              T_NK = "T/NK", CTL = "CTL ‡", Treg = "Treg ‡", TAM = "TAM ‡", Osteoclasts = "Osteoclast ‡"),
                       rev(c("Tumour", "T/NK", "B/plasma", "Myeloid", "Erythroid/progenitor", "Bone cells", "Stromal", "Endothelial", "CTL ‡", "Treg ‡", "TAM ‡", "Osteoclast ‡"))),
         txt = paste0(sprintf("%+.1f", median_change_pp), ifelse(fdr_change < 0.05, "**", ifelse(fdr_change < 0.1, "†", ""))))
e9g <- ggplot(dc, aes(segment, cell, fill = median_change_pp)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) + geom_text(aes(label = txt), size = 1.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-8, 8), oob = squish, name = "Median\nchange\n(points)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_tile + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
save_fig(e9a / e9b / ((e9c | e9d) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.15))) / e9e / ((e9f | e9g) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.25, 1))) +
           plot_layout(heights = c(0.75, 1.0, 1.15, 0.55, 1.6)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a"), "ExtendedDataFig9", 360)

```

### v4 Extended Data Fig. 10 = final Extended Data Fig. 7
Owen et al. marker genes detected above LOQ vs PSA change per stratum (Spearman ρ; * P < 0.05; ‡ P < 0.05 in every leave-one-out refit), ordered by mean ρ.

```{r comp-28-figures-v4-16}
## =====================================================================================
## ED10 -- Owen et al. markers vs response, gene level
## =====================================================================================
rg <- read.csv(file.path(R7, "E_owen_markers_vs_response.csv")) %>% filter(type == "gene") %>% strat_cols() %>%
  mutate(tpl = factor(c(Archival = "Primary", Screening = "Bone pre", Cycle1 = "Bone on")[as.character(timepoint)], c("Primary", "Bone pre", "Bone on")),
         mark = ifelse(p_rho < 0.05 & p_LOO_worst < 0.05, "‡", stars(p_rho)))
gl <- rg %>% group_by(feature) %>% summarise(m = mean(rho, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% arrange(m) %>% pull(feature)
e10 <- ggplot(rg %>% mutate(feature = factor(feature, gl)), aes(tpl, feature, fill = rho)) + geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = mark), size = 1.9, vjust = 0.75) + facet_grid(~seg_label) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = div_pal[1], mid = div_pal[2], high = div_pal[3], limits = c(-0.8, 0.8), oob = squish, name = "ρ with\nPSA change") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Owen et al. markers (genes detected above LOQ) vs PSA response", subtitle = "Patient pseudobulk; * P < 0.05; ‡ P < 0.05 at every leave-one-out; blank = below LOQ") +
  theme_tile + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 5.4), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
save_fig(e10, "ExtendedDataFig10", 150, 150)
cat("v4 figures complete.\n")
```
